Name: Jehohanan, Captain of Judah
Summary: Jehohanan was a captain under Jehoshaphat, next to Adnah, with two hundred and fourscore thousand men.
KeyStory: Next to Adnah was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
